_comment: English overrides for product-surface strings in the pinned Agent Canvas (apps/canvas/brand.mjs). After these, every remaining "OpenHands" in every locale becomes "AtherNull"; the brand check fails the build on anything left.
HOME$OPENHANDS_DESCRIPTION: AtherNull turns a prompt into a funded, verified build by an AI agent.
LANDING$SUBTITLE: AtherNull turns a prompt into a funded, verified build by an AI agent.
ONBOARDING$BACKEND_SUBTITLE: AtherNull runs your agent in your organization's private sandbox.
ONBOARDING$HELLO_SUBTITLE: Describe what you want built. AtherNull plans it, you fund it, and the agent builds it.
ONBOARDING$HELLO_DEFAULT_MESSAGE: Add a /health endpoint with a test.
ONBOARDING$USE_CASE_QUESTION: What do you want to use AtherNull for?
CHAT_INTERFACE$INITIAL_MESSAGE: Hi! I'm your AtherNull agent. What would you like to build?
SETTINGS$EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: You must verify your email address before using AtherNull
FEEDBACK$THANK_YOU_FOR_FEEDBACK: Thank you for your feedback! It helps us improve AtherNull.
BROWSER$EMPTY_MESSAGE: If you ask the agent to start a web server, the app will appear here.
BROWSER$NO_PAGE_LOADED: No page loaded yet. Ask the agent to open a URL. Example: "Open https://example.com"
BROWSER$SERVER_MESSAGE: No web app running. Ask the agent to start your project's dev server (for example: npm run dev).
DIFF_VIEWER$ASK_OH: Ask the agent to initialize a git repo to activate this UI.
DIFF_VIEWER$NO_CHANGES: The agent hasn't made any changes yet
SETTINGS$GIT_SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Configure the username and email the agent uses to commit changes.
SCHEMA$AGENT_CONTEXT$LOAD_MEMORY$DESCRIP: The agent keeps notes in your workspace and loads them at the start of each new conversation, learning your codebase and preferences over time.
AUTH$RECAPTCHA_BLOCKED: Access blocked due to suspicious activity. If you believe this is an error, contact AtherNull support.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Configure the AtherNull Agent that drives your conversations.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PROFILE_NO_LLM: Your workspace LLM is still being set up. Try again in a moment.
COMMAND_MENU$NEW_CHAT_DESCRIPTION: Start a new conversation with the agent.
ONBOARDING$AGENT_OPENHANDS_DESCRIPTION: The AtherNull Agent. Plans, builds and tests changes in your workspace.
SETTINGS$SKILLS_ADD_MODAL_INTRO: Extend what your agent can do by installing skills from community repositories or your own GitHub repos.
SETTINGS$SKILLS_ADD_MODAL_URL_FORMATS: Full GitHub tree links, repository paths, and short forms such as owner/repo/skills/name all work.
SETTINGS$BACKEND_SYNCED_BADGE: These settings are saved in your AtherNull workspace.
